description: This file defines an internal sealed class PrefixingBufferWriter that implements IBufferWriter<byte> and IDisposable. It manages writing a fixed-size header (prefix) followed by payload data into an underlying PipeWriter, with optimizations to reduce copying. It is used within the Orleans.Runtime.Messaging namespace for efficient buffer management when sending messages.

classes.name: PrefixingBufferWriter
classes.description: An IBufferWriter<byte> that reserves space for a header prefix and efficiently writes payloads, minimizing copying.

classes.name: PrefixingBufferWriter.Sequence
classes.description: Manages a sequence of memory segments for buffering payload data.

classes.name: PrefixingBufferWriter.Sequence.SequenceSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment in the sequence, holding a block of memory for buffering.

methods.name: PrefixingBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer writer with specified prefix size, payload hint, and memory pool.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> for writing payload data, initializing internal buffers if needed.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> for writing payload data, initializing internal buffers if needed.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Writes the prefix and finalizes the payload, committing data to the underlying writer.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the internal innerWriter with a PipeWriter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal state for reuse, disposing private writer and clearing buffers.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the internal private writer if present.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Allocates initial memory from the inner writer, reserving space for the prefix.

methods.name: Sequence.Append
methods.description: Creates a new memory segment with size hint, adds it to the sequence for buffering payload data.

methods.name: Sequence.RecycleAndGetNext
methods.description: Recycles a segment and returns the next segment in the sequence.
